description: This file defines the HttpConfig interface for the Gateway service's HTTP settings, including methods for schema support, HTTPS enforcement, CORS, timeouts, header configurations, media types, and their associated configuration values.

classes.name: HttpConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying HTTP configuration settings for the Gateway service, including schema support, HTTPS enforcement, CORS, timeouts, headers, media types, and configuration value enumeration.

classes.name: HttpConfig.GatewayHttpConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of configuration path expressions and default values for HttpConfig.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns a set of supported JsonSchemaVersion instances.

methods.name: isForceHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether HTTPS enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates if redirection to HTTPS is enabled for HTTP requests.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern for paths that should not be redirected to HTTPS even if redirection is enabled.

methods.name: isEnableCors
methods.description: Indicates whether Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) is enabled.

methods.name: getRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the Duration object representing HTTP request timeout.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Provides the full class name for the HttpRequestActorPropsFactory implementation.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns a set of header definitions derived from query parameters.

methods.name: getAdditionalAcceptedMediaTypes
methods.description: Returns a set of additional media types accepted by endpoints.
